meta.module: tpc_tests 0.2.1 (tpc_zone 0.5.1, schema 0.5.0; tpc_form 0.2.1, with D177.1; tpc_units 0.1.1; tpc_strike 0.2.1), proposed with TPC-PY 0.2.0
meta.note: Every expectation is hand-derived. The toy TFK is the zone corpus's: a mass on a linear spring with z fixed at 0; the spring with its forms adds a DOF t, an entry E_t and the declared forms (increment 8). Both are test fixtures, not physics under research. Both residences MUST reproduce every expect. 0.3.0 (schema 0.5.0; D176.1, D177.1): every fixture LAW carries a ROLE chosen by its physics, no earlier expectation changed; added, the research drafts A21 (scaled time), A10a (the heat equation, under ONE and SEVERAL) and corner_fix_t (a FIXed clock) with ROLEs added, a static beam whose D variable is its arc length, and the TMS switch at the final pass. 0.3.1 (S33, 2026-09-26): a LAW restating the motion of a FIXed or REMOVEd DOF carries ROLE CONSTRAINT (the toy's and the spring's FREE_Z, corner_fix_t's EOM_Z, N2 and KIN of the FIX fixture); a variant whose constraints leave z free gives FREE_Z EOM(z). No expectation moves. 0.3.2 (C-MS-5, increment 11, 2026-09-28): 16 decode/ cases, each a JSON {} where a list is read, a JSON [] where an object is read, an object keyed 0 read as a list, or a valid empty object; TPC-PHP now reads the JSON as written. No earlier expectation moves.
